questions.question: What does <T extends Number> guarantee inside the declaration?
questions.explanation: The upper bound supplies the capabilities of Number while allowing subtypes.

questions.question: Why use T extends Comparable<T> for max?
options: The method needs compareTo between T values
questions.explanation: The bound makes compareTo available with the appropriate operand type.

questions.question: For multiple bounds, which item must appear first?
questions.explanation: Java syntax places the single class bound before interface bounds.

questions.question: A bound is chosen from…
questions.explanation: Require only the smallest capability set necessary.
